Subject: Stormline Shell is back in stock
Preview: 20k/20k waterproof and breathable. 420g. Ready when your next trip is.
Body: The Northbay Stormline Shell Jacket (NB-JKT-07) is restocked.

If you've got a wet-weather trip on the calendar — or you've been caught out without the right layer before — here's what this jacket does:

- 3-layer laminate construction holds up through sustained rain, not just a quick shower
- 20,000mm waterproof rating keeps water out under real pressure
- 20,000 g/m² breathability moves moisture out when you're moving hard
- Weighs 420g — light enough to pack without thinking twice

This is a shell built for serious wet weather. It's not an insulated jacket and it's not rated for extreme alpine cold on its own.

Stock moved fast the last few times. If you need it for an upcoming trip, now's the time.
